text: FDTD integrates Maxwell's two curl equations on Kane ___'s staggered grid, with E components on cell edges and H components on cell faces, offset by half a step in time.
explanation: The Yee cell (Kane Yee, 1966) staggers E and H in both space and time to give an explicit, second-order-accurate leapfrog update that parallelizes almost perfectly. This staggering is the foundation of the entire FDTD algorithm.
